caption: Validation MSE is lowest at degree 3 (1.4), the model to pick, then climbs to 6.8 at degree 9 while training MSE drops to 0.01. Degree 1 has both errors high (4.2 and 4.5): underfitting; degree 9 has a gap of 6.79: overfitting.

spec.aria: Training MSE falls from 4.2 at degree 1 to 0.01 at degree 9, while validation MSE falls from 4.5 to its lowest 1.4 at degree 3 and then rises to 6.8 at degree 9.
